p0025_1.t: Population by Occupation (Major Group), Industrial Status, Age and Marital Status

p0031_2.d: Gives the present population, the usual resident population by sex, and persons temporarily present and temporarily absent, by prefecture and for cities with 50,000 or more usual residents, at the census of 1935.

p0033_2.d: Gives the population of each prefecture by registered domicile (Japanese, Korean, Taiwanese, Karafuto, South Seas) and by foreign nationality, at the census of 1 October 1930 with 1920 totals.

p0034_1.t: Marriages, Divorces, Births, Stillbirths and Deaths
